typesetting_rules: No Inter or generic sans for Main and Sub-headings
Main titles must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) with loose leading on body copy
Hero heading max ceiling text-6xl (avoid poster-scale text-8xl)
Bilingual-ready Bahasa Indonesia copy written with poetic, premium sensory clarity ('Wanginya Tahan 14 Hari', 'Sentuhan Selembut Sutra')

contrast_rules: White text strictly on Vivid Purple (#7E22CE) and Royal Deep (#581C87) buttons to achieve >7:1 APCA contrast
Text on soft lavender surfaces must use Deep Royal Ink (#1E1329) or #581C87 to guarantee WCAG AAA legibility
Headers and navigation bars must never be transparent; use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 border-b border-purple-100 shadow-sm'
Dropdown menus, modals, and tooltips must have solid opaque backgrounds (bg-white or bg-[#FAF7FD])

1_outlet_distance_finder.purpose: Allow user to click 'Cari Outlet Terdekat Saya' via browser navigator.geolocation (or search district manually: Jakarta, Bandung, Depok). Calculates Haversine distance in KM and highlights the closest Jadiwangi branch with direct WA pickup button and estimated delivery fee.

2_instant_price_estimator.purpose: Interactive interactive simulator. Users select outlet branch, laundry category (Kiloan Cuci-Kering-Setrika, Cuci Lipat, Setrika Saja, Bed Cover Single/King, Sepatu & Tas, Karpet), input estimated weight or quantity with reactive slider/stepper, and select delivery distance slider (0 to 5km). Shows live calculated subtotal + delivery fee breakdown + instant WhatsApp Order format generator with pre-filled message.
2_instant_price_estimator.sample_wa_message: Halo Admin Jadiwangi Laundry Outlet [Outlet]! Saya mau order laundry: [Layanan] sebanyak [Qty/Kg]. Estimasi jarak [Jarak] km. Mohon info penjemputan ke alamat saya ya kak.

3_google_maps_5star_reviews.purpose: Showcase real verified 5-star Google Maps reviews from customer testimonials across the 3 outlets. Filterable by outlet branch. Displays customer avatar, verified badge, review date, 5 golden stars, and quoted testimonial about smell longevity, punctuality, and crisp packaging.

4_slow_editorial_marquee.purpose: Living ribbon ticker with luxury lavender scent benefits, organic detergent cert, 14-day scent guarantee, 100% no-mixed-wash policy, and free delivery info.

5_whatsapp_floating_order_bar.purpose: Persistent subtle bottom floating bar or corner CTA on mobile & desktop showing selected outlet + quick 1-click 'Order via WhatsApp' button with direct wa.me link.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete responsive landing page in React JS (/app/frontend/src/App.js and modular components under /app/frontend/src/components/).
Install necessary icon packs like lucide-react (already present) or framer-motion (already present in package.json) for smooth animated accordions, modals, and tab switches.

Implement real geolocation distance calculation using the Haversine formula (calculate distance in KM from user's lat/lng to Pulomas -6.1772, 106.8839; Ujungberung -6.9142, 107.6972; Kalimulya -6.4258, 106.8286). Provide fallback manual buttons if geolocation is denied or unavailable.
Ensure delivery fee calculation matches the rule: distance <= 2.0 km is FREE (Rp 0), and distance between 2.1 km to 5.0 km adds Rp 2.500 - Rp 3.000 / km.

Make WhatsApp CTA buttons active and functional: generate direct links like 'https://wa.me/6281290001821?text=...' containing pre-formatted messages with the chosen outlet, customer address, and laundry service.
Maintain the strict color scheme: Lavender (#E9D5FF, #F3E8FF) and Vivid Purple (#7E22CE, #6B21A8, #581C87). Do not use cyan, neon green or generic SaaS blue.
Ensure every interactive element has the designated data-testid attribute for automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS; keep layouts naturally aligned and asymmetric.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic flat cards, or heavy opaque dark overlays. Keep visual air and sensory crispness.
Never use pure black #000000; use #1E1329 for luxury deep plum ink tones.
Ensure all buttons have active, hover, and focus states with clear contrast.
